purpose: Test one prospectively frozen hypothesis that scheduled macroeconomic announcements create a temporary price-discovery regime in BTC/ETH in which short-horizon taker-flow persistence contains incremental information about subsequent same-direction price continuation.
scientific_principle: Correct infrastructure, never help the hypothesis survive.

independent_ex_ante_basis.mechanism: Scheduled macro announcements generate abrupt changes in volatility, volume, spreads/liquidity and order flow; external literature supports elevated market-quality effects for roughly the first 30 minutes and a material role for order flow in price discovery.
independent_ex_ante_basis.reason: Macro surprise sign has state-dependent mapping through yields, USD and risk sentiment; the primary hypothesis therefore conditions on realized market microstructure rather than forcing a simple CPI/NFP/FOMC direction map.
independent_ex_ante_basis.reason_time_region: Chosen from independent literature on announcement microstructure rather than optimized from the laboratory's 2021-2025 outcomes.

single_primary_hypothesis.statement: Within the first 30 minutes after a scheduled US CPI, NFP or FOMC release, if taker-flow direction is persistent across two consecutive pre-specified subwindows, the subsequent non-overlapping return window is more likely than matched non-event controls to continue in the same direction as the persistent flow.

frozen_windows.rationale: All windows remain inside the independently justified ~30-minute announcement price-discovery region. The 15-30 outcome horizon avoids selecting the previously observed 15-60 discovery result.

flow_definition.source: official Binance Spot trade/aggTrade fields sufficient to identify taker side
flow_definition.persistence_rule: flow_window_1 and flow_window_2 must both be non-zero and have identical sign
flow_definition.reason_no_threshold: Avoid post-outcome tuning and arbitrary cutoffs.

outcome_definition.continuation_success: sign(outcome_return) equals persistent_flow_sign and outcome_return is non-zero
outcome_definition.reason: Primary hypothesis tests predictive structure, not yet an executable trading strategy.

primary_statistic.name: continuation_rate_difference
primary_statistic.definition: P(continuation_success | persistent flow, macro event) - P(continuation_success | persistent flow, matched controls)

minimum_sample_contract.rationale: This is a one-year holdout with scheduled events, so a 100-event requirement would mechanically force INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE. The thresholds are frozen before holdout access and apply symmetrically regardless of result.

requirements: all data-integrity and governance gates pass
SURVIVES.meaning: Predictive microstructure structure survives this holdout. It does NOT by itself authorize live trading.

requirements: all data-integrity and governance gates pass
minimum sample contract is not met
required source data are missing, corrupt, timestamp-inconsistent, or control construction fails contract
TECHNICAL_OR_DATA_FAILURE.rule: May justify infrastructure repair only; no scientific parameter may be changed to improve the hypothesis.

abort_before_outcome_evaluation_if: any 2026 data were accessed before explicit holdout unlock
event calendar cannot be independently reconstructed from official sources
any outcome-dependent parameter edit is detected
any secondary symbol, event family, threshold or window is introduced after outcomes are visible
explicitly_forbidden: choosing ETH because prior discovery looked stronger
choosing CPI only because prior discovery looked stronger
using 15_to_60_minutes because prior discovery showed a favorable continuation rate
switching between continuation and reversal after seeing holdout outcomes
opening 2026 before a separate explicit holdout authorization
secondary_descriptive_outputs_allowed_af: volume and trade-count ratios versus matched controls
secondary_output_rule: Descriptive only. No subgroup can change the primary classification and no subgroup result may be promoted to a new edge without a new prospective freeze and untouched data.
